description: Fetch full detail for a single New Zealand government tender from GETS by its RFx ID (the numeric id from nz_tender_open / nz_tender_search results, e.g. 32705858). Returns tender name, reference number, buying agency, department/business unit, tender type (RFP, RFT, RFQ, etc.), coverage, open and close dates, UNSPSC categories, regions, required pre-qualifications, contact, full overview text, and the human GETS page URL.
name: nz_tender_detail
title: Nz Tender Detail
